claims_boundary: Seeds define search domains and questions, not validated capabilities.
No seed authorizes external execution, claim promotion, partner engagement, or physical validation.
Negative and contradictory evidence must be retained.

seeds.statement: Continuously search for reproducible observations, improved measurement architectures, systematics controls, facility-access paths, and disconfirming evidence relevant to QVOS.
falsification_tests: separate Standard Model predictions from instrumental or material effects

seeds.statement: Search for advances in optical clocks, quantum RF sensing, spin ensembles, Rydberg sensors, distributed timing, and loss-tolerant metrology that can strengthen ECHO-TIME and APNT.
falsification_tests: compare claimed sensitivity and robustness against independent benchmarks

seeds.domain: photonics metasurfaces and programmable electromagnetic boundaries
seeds.statement: Search for full-wave, materials, plasma, thermal, fabrication, broadband, and measured-device evidence that can validate or falsify Worldshepherd programmable-boundary hypotheses.
falsification_tests: prefer calibrated measured controls over simulation-only improvement

seeds.statement: Search across conventional, electric, plasma, thermal, chemical, nuclear, beamed-energy, and emerging propulsion for validated performance, failure modes, integration gaps, test facilities, and opportunity demand.
falsification_tests: require complete momentum and energy accounting for anomalous-force claims

seeds.statement: Search for measured improvements and persistent limitations in locomotion, manipulation, perception, energy, reliability, safety, autonomy, and governed physical interaction.
falsification_tests: separate benchmark wins from general physical competence

seeds.statement: Search for contested-spectrum, DDIL, assured-PNT, coherent timing, RF classification, networking, synchronization, and degraded-state evidence relevant to Worldshepherd mission assurance.
falsification_tests: test graceful degradation and recovery under explicit denial and deception

seeds.domain: AI governance agent assurance and TEVV
seeds.statement: Search for standards, evaluations, failure taxonomies, red-team methods, agent security, post-deployment monitoring, and independent benchmarks that can strengthen PRIME, SARA, ECHO, and OVERWATCH.
falsification_tests: prefer independent blind evaluation over self-reported model performance

seeds.statement: Search for secure hardware, firmware, SBOM, attestation, supply-chain identity, cryptographic provenance, recovery, and tamper-evidence methods applicable to ECHO-HW.
falsification_tests: verify provenance controls against tamper and rollback scenarios

seeds.statement: Search for composition-process-structure-property relationships, DED and additive-manufacturing evidence, degradation models, autonomous materials experiments, and independent validation routes for Worldshepherd materials lanes.
falsification_tests: preserve baseline and candidate builds with independent characterization and uncertainty

seeds.domain: energy generation storage conversion and transmission
seeds.statement: Search for validated advances in generation, storage, thermal management, power electronics, beamed energy, grid resilience, and energy conversion relevant to Worldshepherd systems.
falsification_tests: require complete input-output energy boundaries and uncertainty

seeds.domain: medical biotechnology genetics and programmable cells
seeds.statement: Search for validated advances in sequencing, gene regulation, cell programming, therapeutics, diagnostics, medical physics, and autonomous biotechnology while preserving research-only and clinical-governance boundaries.
falsification_tests: separate preclinical, clinical, and regulatory evidence levels

seeds.statement: Search for sensing, remediation, water, air, ecosystem, disaster-recovery, climate-resilience, and infrastructure technologies that can reuse Worldshepherd provenance and autonomous experimentation.
falsification_tests: compare intervention outcomes against preregistered baselines

seeds.statement: Search for closed-loop manufacturing, autonomous laboratories, digital twins, model-predictive control, metrology, and qualification workflows that can connect SARA to physical experimentation.
falsification_tests: quantify sim-to-real error and retain discrepancies

seeds.domain: mission assurance MBSE and digital engineering
seeds.statement: Search for requirements, architecture, verification, model-based systems engineering, digital-thread, configuration-custody, and evidence-packaging advances that improve cross-project Worldshepherd assurance.
falsification_tests: trace each promoted requirement or capability to source and test evidence

seeds.domain: government programs funding standards and procurement demand
seeds.statement: Continuously discover current and predicted government requirements, funding paths, standards, testbeds, user facilities, consortiums, OTAs, SBIR/STTR topics, and transition signals relevant to PRE.
falsification_tests: verify opportunity facts against official sources before capture-ready classification

seeds.domain: commercial marketplace partners competitors and prior art
seeds.statement: Search for commercial capabilities, partner complementarity, competitive conflicts, prior art, supplier readiness, pricing signals, market gaps, and transition paths across all Worldshepherd lanes.
falsification_tests: actively search for existing products or patents that remove claimed novelty

seeds.domain: fundamental science anomaly and negative-space search
seeds.statement: Search across credible scientific domains for reproducible anomalies, failed predictions, unexpected nulls, cross-domain mathematical structures, and measurements that warrant new bounded hypotheses.
falsification_tests: seek conventional explanations and independent replication before new-physics interpretation

seeds.statement: Continuously search Worldshepherd evidence, claims, tests, failures, open pull requests, external responses, and requirements for contradictions, stale assumptions, missing evidence, and cheaper disconfirming tests.
falsification_tests: treat internal claims as hypotheses until their current evidence chain is verified
